name: Siri and Shortcuts (App Intents)
description: An App Intent that opens the app at a chosen screen, exposed as an App Shortcut so it works in Siri, Spotlight and the Shortcuts app without setup.
usage: Edit `AppScreen` cases to the app's top-level screens (ids should match the screen ids in the plan). Observe `IntentNavigation.shared.requested` in the root view and switch to that screen, then set it back to nil. Add more intents for real actions (for example reorder the last order) following the same pattern.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify app-intents-shortcuts` on a Mac with Xcode.
